title: POPANE-P2a Study 5 outcome-blind schema preflight
classification: Validity-dependency resolution under MANUSCRIPT-GATE-01 CLASS C.
purpose: Assess whether POPANE Study 5 can provide a genuinely separate continuous-valence physiology validation/replication after Study 6 failed the aligned-signal positive control, without tuning Study 6 after its outcome.

rationale.selection: Study 5 is selected from the published POPANE descriptor before inspecting Study 5 observational values because it is the largest other reported continuous-valence POPANE study (published N=199), uses a distinct study/task and includes positive, negative and neutral emotion elicitation with ECG/EDA.
rationale.nonselection: It was not selected from any Study 5 model performance or signal outcome.

source.published_design: Baseline, three rounds of film clips, and responses to partner success/capitalization.

allowed_reads: For deterministic sampled CSVs, metadata comment lines and the first actual column header only; stop before first data row.
forbidden: No outcome-based segment or participant exclusion
qc: number of participant IDs and named nonbaseline segments from filenames
presence of timestamp/sample index, affect/valence, ECG and EDA
whether segment labels are independently recoverable from filenames

decision.PASS_STUDY5_VALIDATION_FEASIBLE: Synchronized valence + time + ECG/EDA are present, >=20 participants, and >=2 named nonbaseline segments.

next_if_pass: Freeze a Study 5 analysis before reading values. The analysis must first test aligned physiology signal; prospective incremental forecasting is interpreted only if the positive-control criterion is met or reported transparently if it does not.
